benchmark_issues_open: Contract-13 proposal: drop the keepalive instruction from the genesis brief and stop removing seeded jobs by editing schedule.toml. Before the watch, the controller sends one owner message (e.g. OWNER_SETUP: "pause your keepalive with Cron action=update id=keepalive enabled=false") through the owner DM, so a run the owner starts in person pauses it. OpenClaw's heartbeat is disabled through its native configuration, so this restores symmetry; the setup message counts as a setup call, not a watch action.

Setup requests share the 60-request operating allowance: a longer genesis leaves fewer requests for the watch (pairs 3, 5, 6 hit 429 at the last slots). A separate setup allowance would stop formation variance from leaking into the watch.
OpenClaw native transcript usage exceeded the relay in pair 3 (+7 requests) and fell short by 3 interrupted calls without usage in pair 10; the gate reports both as unexplained.
